newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - December 19.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - December 19.

text.p: The Federal Reserve said it had one large net miss in its reserve projections in the latest week, a Fed spokeswoman said.

The miss, which occured on Tuesday, resulted in fewer reserves than anticipated. Treasury deposits at the Fed on that day were much higher than anticipated, which drained reserves in the banking system, she added.
The high in natural float was about $2.7 billion on Tuesday, while the low was a bit over $750 million on Thursday.
Transportation float averaged a bit under $150 million per day, with the high on Wednesday at a bit over $500 million primarily due to weather-related problems in several eastern cities.
